detail.longDescription: Been thinking a lot about how hard it is to get field-normalized citation metrics (like FWCI) without paying for Scopus or institutional subscriptions. Just found out you can pull live, open-source FWCI breakdowns directly from your ORCID and OpenAlex records—no paywall or account needed. Here’s how mine looks in the wild: https:// frontierresearch.co/check/rese archer?q=0000-0002-4355-2169 # OpenScience # OpenAccess # Bibliometrics # AcademicChatter # ORCID # MaterialsScience # MechanicalEngineering # Engineering # Science # DataScience # MachineLearning
